description: This file is a shell script written in sh which contains a comprehensive suite of tests for the 'git sparse-checkout' feature. It covers various functionalities such as initialization, setting patterns, adding patterns, cone mode operations, error handling, interaction with submodules, worktrees, and other edge cases related to sparse checkout in Git.

methods.name: list_files
methods.description: Lists files in a directory, excluding special entries like '.' and '..'.

methods.name: check_files
methods.description: Checks that specified files or directories exist in the repository.

methods.name: check_read_tree_errors
methods.description: Runs a read-tree command expecting specific errors or no errors, and checks file presence.
